## Checklist

- [ ] Skill folder is under `.cursor/skills/<skill-name>/`
- [ ] `SKILL.md` includes `name` and `description` frontmatter
- [ ] Description covers both what the skill does and when to use it
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or private paths
- [ ] README Skills table updated (for new skills)
- [ ] Supporting files linked from `SKILL.md` when present

## Test plan

- [ ] Verified output matches the skill instructions / examples
